findings.text: _gate_command_fault refuses any single word of the tests: line that resolves under the temp root, so an honest command that only sets a scratch location there (UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache, TMPDIR=/tmp, pytest --basetemp=/tmp/x) is refused at delivery and again at promotion, while the repair verb this delivery adds re-points suite arms only and leaves the tests line with no remedy once the worker's turn has ended.

resolves_under re-implements the path containment reckon/crew/reports.py:3340 owns and reports.py:3291 uses, differing only in expanduser, and _command_words at manifest_faults.py:163 is a weaker second implementation of the command scan reckon/shadow_reads.py:270 owns, with no variable expansion.
_ARM_FIELDS restates the suite-arm field vocabulary reckon/ledger.py:513 owns, so a field added to one list will silently fail to reach the other rule.

an arm recorded as none parses to an empty record, so re-pointing it writes only revision and both readers then refuse the arm for missing exit_status, completed, failure_count and log; it also loses the empty-base-arm acceptance promotion_records._arm_declares_no_measurement grants that same delivery.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: b3737ed97e adds the rules module, both wirings, the arm verb and the empty-base-arm acceptance; 41bbcbc687 narrows the arm rule to prose or abbreviation and resolves a cited entry through the pre-existing reports._citation_tokens at promotion_scope.py:344; 95047fc36e and 875c0cc2d5 are the evidence fragment; 105a6b668d brings primary under the delivery and keeps both citation reads, with the token read first and the admission read as a second attempt.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for a table-driven test over both readers with one shared reason, a test promoting a run whose only new test file has no base arm, a test re-pointing an arm through the verb keeping the as-delivered file, and a base-revision negative control; the first is tests/test_a_manifest_is_refused_for_what_promotion_refuses.py:212, the second at :296 and :327, the third tests/test_a_suite_arm_is_repointed_keeping_the_delivered_file.py:86, and the control is negative-control-base-revision.log, which shows the base revision's check reporting ok=True for the prose row its promotion refuses.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that a manifest is refused while its worker is live for anything promotion would refuse; reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py:75 states each rule once and both readers ask it, at reckon/crew/reports.py:2949 in the pre-delivery check and at reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:607 at the gate, so one defect yields one sentence on both sides.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, commits b3737ed97e 41bbcbc687 95047fc36e 875c0cc2d5 plus three integration commits ending at 105a6b668d, node gate 122 passed EXIT=0 at 105a6b668d, base arm 55 passed at a346fba4, after arm 58 passed at 105a6b668d, and negative_control_log named and readable.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The brief declares reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround and skills; every path in the node's own four commits lies inside them, being 8 modules under reckon, 3 test files and 1 evidence fragment, and no skills path was touched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_manifest_is_refused_for_what_promotion_refuses.py:256 withdraws manifest_faults.manifest_faults and shows the same prose delivery reading clean, so the row's finding is the rule's rather than an unrelated refusal.
justifications.evidence: node-gate.log records 122 passed with EXIT=0 at 105a6b668d over the two new test files and tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py, and negative-control-base-revision.log shows the base revision's check passing the prose row its promotion refuses, though the four table rows omit the citation fault that converged.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/manifest_faults.py:1-35 follows the prose idiom of its neighbours and names every symbol by what it judges, with no plan, defect or stage label in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:1307 registers the new guard beside the status guard in the same refusal chain, and reckon/crew/reports.py:2949 appends the same module's reasons to the worker's findings, so the check and the gate state one reason for one fault.
justifications.reuse: promotion_scope.py:344 reuses the pre-existing reports._citation_tokens, but manifest_faults.py:111 duplicates reports._resolves_under, manifest_faults.py:163 duplicates the command scan at reckon/shadow_reads.py:270, and promotion_records.py:668 restates the arm vocabulary at reckon/ledger.py:513.
justifications.scope_discipline: every added or changed path lies inside the declared write paths, and tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py:63 changes only the fixture revision to a full object id the narrowed arm rule now requires.
